description: This file contains implementation of a dynamic buffer management system used internally within the libcurl project. It provides functions to initialize, free, reset, append data, adjust tail contents, and manage buffer length for dynamic string/buffer manipulations.

methods.name: void Curl_dyn_init(struct dynbuf * s,size_t toobig)
methods.description: Initializes a dynamic buffer structure with optional size limit.

methods.name: void Curl_dyn_free(struct dynbuf * s)
methods.description: Frees the internal buffer of the dynamic buffer and resets size counters.

methods.name: CURLcode dyn_nappend(struct dynbuf * s,const unsigned char * mem,size_t len)
methods.description: Internal function that appends raw memory to the buffer, reallocating when necessary.

methods.name: void Curl_dyn_reset(struct dynbuf * s)
methods.description: Resets the buffer contents to an empty string without freeing memory.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_dyn_tail(struct dynbuf * s,size_t trail)
methods.description: Keeps only the last 'trail' bytes of the buffer, discarding the rest.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_dyn_addn(struct dynbuf * s,const void * mem,size_t len)
methods.description: Appends raw data of specified length to the buffer.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_dyn_add(struct dynbuf * s,const char * str)
methods.description: Appends a null-terminated string to the buffer.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_dyn_vaddf(struct dynbuf * s,const char * fmt,va_list ap)
methods.description: Appends a formatted string (vprintf style) to the buffer.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_dyn_addf(struct dynbuf * s,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Appends a formatted string (printf style) to the buffer.

methods.name: char * Curl_dyn_ptr(const struct dynbuf * s)
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the internal buffer.

methods.name: unsigned char * Curl_dyn_uptr(const struct dynbuf * s)
methods.description: Returns an unsigned char pointer to the internal buffer.

methods.name: size_t Curl_dyn_len(const struct dynbuf * s)
methods.description: Returns the current length of data in the buffer.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_dyn_setlen(struct dynbuf * s,size_t set)
methods.description: Sets a new length for the buffer, truncating or adjusting as needed.

ctags.name: Curl_dyn_addn
ctags.pattern: /^CURLcode Curl_dyn_addn(struct dynbuf *s, const void *mem, size_t len)$/

ctags.name: Curl_dyn_vaddf
ctags.pattern: /^CURLcode Curl_dyn_vaddf(struct dynbuf *s, const char *fmt, va_list ap)$/

ctags.name: dyn_nappend
ctags.signature: (struct dynbuf * s,const unsigned char * mem,size_t len)
